items.a: 警犬只是我们人生的一个过客, 但是我又是警犬的一生. [[passerby-vs-entire-life]]. Zhou is on his **fourth** dog. The dog gets **one** person.
[[seven-year-service-clock]]. **~7 years** on. **9–11** alive. **12** is the long one. 妞妞 died **six months** after the uniform came off.

items.q: What does 相信自己的犬 actually mean?
items.a: [[trust-the-dog]]. Read **重嗅**, do not override. Zhou almost walks 云九 off a **second hide** that was already in the air. Hunt drive over food drive: ignore the bowl.

items.q: Who eats better, the dog or the handler?
items.a: 云九: mess **¥10k/year**, all-in **~¥20k+**. Zhou's own food **<¥1,000/month**. He still steals his son's milk and his wife's 鱼肝油.

items.q: What happens when Yuan sees 黑德 after five years?
items.a: A tail wag on the floor. Not a leap. 她依然是我的德子. Not a medal dog. **我也觉得他最好.**

items.q: Do they know they are heroes?
items.a: [[dont-know-the-uniform]]. 16 graves at old 江桥, facing the kennels and the 瑞丽江. They do not know the badge. They still did the work.
